title: Environment live embed
description: Configuration of an environment's public live embed: whether it is on, whether it shows the 3D scene or one camera sensor, and the 3D camera pose. Written by update_embed. Rules kept in Python: only sharing administrators change enabled; enabling needs camera; in sensor mode twin_uuid must be a twin of this environment and sensor_id one of its rgb or depth sensors.

enabled.description: Whether the embed link is live.

mode.description: The 3D scene or a single camera sensor.

camera.description: 3D camera pose in the environment frame.

twin_uuid.description: Camera twin in this environment; used in sensor mode.

sensor_id.description: Sensor of that twin; used in sensor mode.

link_uuid.description: The reader link share the server created when the embed was enabled.
